question: Does an active CategoryButton styled with the gold treatment become Identity ACT.primary or an NDC primary business action?

authorityFound.finding: The exact rule styles the active category state with gold text/background/border/shadow. data-active=true marks component state in this selector; it is not an ACT.primary binding.

explicitNonEquivalence: Gold styling and data-active=true on CategoryButton describe an active/selected category visual state. They do not establish Identity ACT.primary, and visual ACT.primary must not be collapsed into any NDC business action by styling resemblance.
